review_finding: The prior before_delivery check precedes HTTP header preparation; header construction/scheduling can cross the deadline, or another queue failure can block the arm, before end_headers publishes a200 status.
decision: Retain the request serialization lock through a concrete HTTP publication callback. Prepare buffered headers before a final durable-row/deadline/state check. Serialize that final state check and end_headers against gateway blocking; if200 becomes late/blocked, discard its buffered headers and durably rebind/rebuild504 before publishing. Request-body/native-response semantics stay unchanged.
verification: Real loopback regression delays200 header construction beyond a small test deadline; separate real loopback regression triggers a concurrent queued-request refusal during header construction and verifies no200 header/action is published.
boundaries: New directory only; CPU fake children and local sockets only. No models, CUDA, Q95, Comfy, units or cloud. Whole-tree continuation remains unconditionally false pending kernel-owner integration.
